title: Domain Name System (DNS)
subtopics: motivation: IP addresses are hard to remember
DNS resource record types: A, AAAA, CNAME, MX, NS, PTR, SOA, TXT
DNS resolution process: recursive and iterative

definitions.definition: Domain Name System – hierarchical distributed naming system for mapping hostnames to IP addresses
Fully Qualified Domain Name – complete domain name including all labels to the root
An entry in a DNS zone file describing a name-to-address or other mapping
Time To Live – duration a DNS record may be cached
DNS resolver queries on behalf of the client until a final answer is obtained
DNS resolver returns the best answer it has, client queries next server
Internationalized Domain Name – domain name containing non-ASCII characters
Encoding scheme to represent Unicode domain names in ASCII

learning_objectives: Explain the structure and purpose of the DNS
Use getaddrinfo() and related POSIX primitives
